repos.description: Ghidra is a software reverse engineering (SRE) framework
repos.summary_zh: Ghidra是NSA开源的软件逆向工程框架，提供反汇编、反编译、图形化分析与脚本扩展能力，支持多平台、多处理器指令集。可用于恶意代码分析、漏洞挖掘与团队协作逆向，支持交互与自动化模式，并允许用Java/Python开发扩展，是高端可定制的SRE研究平台。
repos.summary_en: Ghidra is an open-source software reverse engineering framework by the NSA, offering disassembly, decompilation, graphing, and scripting. It supports multiple platforms and processor architectures, enabling malware analysis, vulnerability research, and collaborative SRE in both interactive and automated modes, with extensibility via Java or Python.

repos.description: Multi-account API gateway for Grok Build, Grok Web, and Grok Console
repos.summary_zh: 基于 FastAPI 构建的 Grok 网关，将 Grok Web 能力转换为 OpenAI 兼容 API，支持流式对话、函数工具调用及文生图/视频功能。提供多账号池管理、额度同步和 Anthropic 协议兼容，内置 Admin 后台与 Web Chat 界面，支持 Docker/Vercel 部署，实现企业级 AI 能力统一管理。
repos.summary_en: Grok2API is a FastAPI-based gateway that converts Grok Web capabilities into OpenAI-compatible APIs, enabling seamless integration with existing LLM applications. It supports streaming/non-streaming conversations, function tool calls, and text/image-to-video generation. Key features include multi-account pool management, quota synchronization, Anthropic protocol compatibility, and local media caching. The solution provides a comprehensive Admin backend and Web UI for management, supporting Docker, Vercel, and Render deployment for unified enterprise AI infrastructure.

repos.description: A library of behaviors for agents to build the next generation of user interfaces.
repos.summary_zh: UI SDK 是一个为 AI 智能体设计的用户界面行为库，提供键盘导航、焦点管理、选择、弹出、拖放等交互行为，并内置 ARIA 无障碍支持。通过 @ui-sdk/core 定义原始组件，可无缝适配 React、Vue、Svelte、Solid 和 Web Components，助力智能体快速生成下一代 UI。
repos.summary_en: UI SDK is a library of behaviors for AI agents to build next-generation user interfaces. It provides keyboard navigation, focus, selection, dismissal, popups, drag-and-drop, and ARIA accessibility. Built on @ui-sdk/core, it offers adapters for React, Vue, Svelte, Solid, and Web Components, enabling agents to generate UIs seamlessly.

repos.summary_zh: Librum 是一款基于 Qt 框架构建的开源跨平台电子书阅读与管理应用，核心价值在于融合个人数字图书馆与云同步能力。支持 EPUB 等格式，提供笔记、高亮、AI 辅助工具及深度界面定制，可自托管实现多设备无缝访问。集成 70,000+ 免费书籍资源，以现代化交互设计和隐私优先架构，为追求个性化与可控性的数字阅读者提供一体化解决方案。
repos.summary_en: Librum is an open-source, cross-platform e-book reader built on Qt framework that merges personal digital library management with cloud synchronization. It offers note-taking, highlighting, AI-powered tools, and deep UI customization, supporting self-hosting for multi-device access. Featuring 70,000+ free books and a modern interface, it delivers a privacy-focused, all-in-one reading solution for users seeking personalized digital literacy experiences.

repos.description: 🤹 Access thousands of icons as components on-demand universally.
repos.summary_zh: unplugin-icons 是基于 Iconify 的通用图标组件库，提供超20万图标并支持150+图标集。通过按需加载机制仅打包实际使用的图标，显著减小构建体积。支持 Vite、Webpack 等主流构建工具及 React、Vue 3 等框架，具备自动导入、SSR/SSG 友好、自定义图标等特性，适用于现代前端项目。
repos.summary_en: unplugin-icons is a universal icon library leveraging Iconify, providing 200,000+ icons across 150+ sets. It enables on-demand loading to bundle only used icons, reducing bundle size. Compatible with major build tools (Vite, Webpack, Rollup) and frameworks (React, Vue 3, Svelte), it features auto-importing, custom icons, and SSR/SSG support without FOUC for modern web development.

repos.description: Collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace: aggregate sessions from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Pi, Grok Build, etc. Desktop app, self-hosted server, or Docker.
repos.summary_zh: Codeg 是多智能体 AI 编程协作工作区，统一聚合 Claude Code、Codex、Grok Build 等十余种 AI 编码代理，支持跨代理会话迁移与 @ 委派协作，提供桌面端、自托管服务器、Docker 及移动端全平台部署，让多个 AI 代理在同一结构化界面中协同完成开发任务。
repos.summary_en: Codeg is a collaborative multi-agent AI coding workspace that unifies 15+ AI coding agents—Claude Code, Codex, Grok Build, OpenCode, and more—into a single structured conversation interface with live diffs and project file browsing. It supports cross-agent session import, search, and transfer, plus @-delegation for inter-agent task collaboration in isolated worktrees. Deployable as a desktop app, self-hosted server, Docker container, or mobile apps for iOS and Android, with integrations for Telegram, Lark, and WeChat for remote access.

repos.description: A step-by-step guide to build your own AI agent.
repos.summary_zh: 这是一个18步渐进式教程，从零构建生产级AI智能体。涵盖单智能体能力（工具、记忆、网络访问）、事件驱动架构、多智能体协作及生产化特性。每个步骤提供可运行代码与详细设计决策，使用LiteLLM支持多模型提供商，适合学习与实践。
repos.summary_en: An 18-step progressive tutorial for building production-ready AI agents from scratch. Covers single-agent capabilities (tools, memory, web access), event-driven architecture, multi-agent collaboration, and production features. Each step includes runnable code and design decisions, using LiteLLM for multi-provider support, ideal for learning and practice.

repos.description: 划时代的字体切割工具，CJK与任何字符！支持 otf、ttf、woff2 字体多线程切割，完美地细颗粒度地进行包大小控制。A revolutionary font subetter that supports CJK and any characters! It enables multi-threaded subset of otf, ttf, and woff2 fonts, allowing for precise control over package size.
repos.summary_zh: cn-font-split 是专为Web场景打造的字体子集化工具，通过Rust核心与WebAssembly技术实现秒级切割。针对中文等CJK字符集大包体积痛点，提供细粒度字符拆分与多线程处理，支持OTF/TTF/WOFF2格式及可变字体。跨平台一致性输出，集成Vite等前端工具链，显著优化网页字体加载性能。
repos.summary_en: cn-font-split is a revolutionary font subsetting engine designed for web font optimization, particularly for massive CJK character sets. Built with Rust and WebAssembly, it enables fine-grained character-level splitting with multi-threaded processing, achieving 50ms latency for 2MB fonts. Supporting OTF/TTF/WOFF2 formats, variable fonts, and complex glyph rendering via Harfbuzz integration, it delivers consistent outputs across browsers, Node.js, Deno, Bun, and native platforms. The tool integrates seamlessly with Vite, Webpack, and other frontend toolchains, eliminating render-blocking font loading while reducing bundle sizes by up to 90% and supporting 95+ OpenType features.

repos.description: Ubuntu 26.04 + Phosh for the Xiaomi 12T Pro / Redmi K50 Ultra (diting, SM8475) on mainline Linux: build system, packages, kernel patches
repos.summary_zh: 该仓库将 Ubuntu 26.04 LTS 与 Phosh 移动桌面环境移植至小米 12T Pro/Redmi K50 Ultra（骁龙8+ Gen 1），包含主线 Linux 内核补丁、完整构建系统、Debian 打包及音频/相机/视频解码等硬件适配，实现手机运行完整 Linux 桌面系统。
repos.summary_en: This repository ports Ubuntu 26.04 LTS with the Phosh mobile desktop environment to the Xiaomi 12T Pro / Redmi K50 Ultra (Snapdragon 8+ Gen 1, SM8475). It provides mainline Linux kernel patches, a complete build system, Debian packaging, and hardware enablement for audio, camera, and video decoding (VA-API), enabling a full Linux desktop on a smartphone using upstream stable kernel with device-specific patches.
